matter_background.original: Mala is living with her daughter in Kurunegala. She intends to lease out her own house in Colombo for a monthly rental of Rs. 100,000/ for two years to Sheela. The rentals of the house have to be paid on the 20th day of each month commencing from 2020. Mala obtained a refundable deposit of Rs. 300,000/ from Sheela. She also obtained an advance payment of Rs. 600,000/ and intends it to be set off against the 1st year's monthly rental.
